description: This is the main source file for a Flutter mobile app, defining the app's entry point, main widget, and a page that lists HTML assets for previewing in a WebView.

classes.name: MyApp
classes.description: Root widget for the Flutter application, sets up MaterialApp with theme and initial route.

classes.name: HtmlListPage
classes.description: Displays a list of HTML assets for preview within a WebView, allowing navigation to individual web pages.

methods.name: main
methods.description: Entry point of the Flutter app, initializes and runs the MyApp widget.

methods.name: build
methods.description: Builds the widget tree for MyApp and HtmlListPage, defining UI layout and interaction.
